name: standing-orders
description: Keeps the instructions you give Claude ("never…", "from now on…", "in this project…") as standing orders for the project or the session, offered in a band above the prompt, and hands them back to Claude after every compaction or /clear, with the active /goal. No model calls.

capture.title: Offer to keep instructions
capture.description: When a prompt gives a lasting instruction (always, never, don't, from now on, make sure to, in this project…), offer to keep it as a standing order in a band above the prompt. Nothing is kept without your answer.

deliver.title: Give Claude the standing orders
deliver.description: Add the standing orders and the active goal to the conversation's context (at its start and again after each compaction or /clear), and attach an order kept mid-conversation to your next prompt once.

maxOrders.title: Most orders per scope
maxOrders.description: How many standing orders a project, and a session, can hold; /orders forget makes room.
